name: ask-marcel-office-cli
description: Microsoft Graph CLI + library — typed Bun/TypeScript wrapper around 200+ Graph operations (read + on-the-fly PDF/markdown conversion + federated Microsoft Search) reachable from a Teams browser-OAuth token.
author: Vincent Delacourt <vincent.delacourt@adama-development.com>

scripts.check:docs: bun run scripts/check-doc-numbers.ts --package read/src/composition/single-package.ts --package write/src/composition/write-package.ts --readme README.md --commands-doc docs/COMMANDS.md --usage docs/USAGE.md --manifest docs/commands.json
scripts.docs:gen: bun run scripts/gen-docs.ts --package read/src/composition/single-package.ts --package write/src/composition/write-package.ts --manifest docs/commands.json --commands-doc docs/COMMANDS.md
